bash: {"command": "{
  cat <<'EOS' > /tmp/collect_vps_audit.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
OUT="/tmp/vps_audit_report.txt"
: > "$OUT"

section() {
  printf "\n## %s\n" "$1" >> "$OUT"
}

section "ОС и ядро"
uname -srvmo >> "$OUT"
if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
  echo '--- /etc/os-release ---' >> "$OUT"
  cat /etc/os-release >> "$OUT"
fi
if [ -f /etc/issue ]; then
  echo '--- /etc/issue (first line) ---' >> "$OUT"
  head -n1 /etc/issue >> "$OUT"
fi

section "Время и часовой пояс"
date -u '+UTC: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' >> "$OUT"
date '+Local: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z (%:z)' >> "$OUT"
timedatectl 2>/dev/null || echo 'timedatectl: not available' >> "$OUT"
ntpq -p 2>/dev/null || echo 'ntpq: not available' >> "$OUT"

section "Аппаратные ресурсы"
if command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  lscpu >> "$OUT"
else
  echo 'lscpu: not available' >> "$OUT"
fi
if [ -r /proc/cpuinfo ]; then
  echo '--- CPU model (first 2 lines) ---' >> "$OUT"
  head -n2 /proc/cpuinfo >> "$OUT"
fi
free -h >> "$OUT"
vmstat 1 2 2>/dev/null | tail -n +3 >> "$OUT" || true

section "Диски, ФС и иноды"
df -hT >> "$OUT"
df -i >> "$OUT"
lsblk -d -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,ROTA,MODEL 2>/dev/null || echo 'lsblk: not available' >> "$OUT"
blkid 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 >> "$OUT" || true

section "Сеть"
ip -br addr >> "$OUT"
ip -4 route show 2>/dev/null || echo 'ip route (IPv4): not available' >> "$OUT"
ip -6 route show 2>/dev/null || echo 'ip route (IPv6): not available' >> "$OUT"
ss -tulpen 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
resolvectl status 2>/dev/null || echo 'resolvectl: not available' >> "$OUT"
grep -E '^(nameserver|search|domain)' /etc/resolv.conf 2>/dev/null || true >> "$OUT"

section "Пользователи и группы"
echo '--- /etc/passwd (non-system UIDs) ---' >> "$OUT"
awk -F: '$3>=1000 || $3==0 {print $1,$3,$6}' /etc/passwd | head -n 50 >> "$OUT"
echo '--- /etc/group (non-system GIDs) ---' >> "$OUT"
awk -F: '$3>=1000 || $3==0 {print $1,$3}' /etc/group | head -n 50 >> "$OUT"
echo '--- sudoers drop-ins (list) ---' >> "$OUT"
if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ]; then
  ls -l /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null || true >> "$OUT"
fi
if [ -f /etc/sudoers ]; then
  echo '--- /etc/sudoers (comments stripped) ---' >> "$OUT"
  grep -v '^#' /etc/sudoers | grep -v '^$' | head -n 100 >> "$OUT"
fi

section "Сервисы (systemd)"
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --state=enabled --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
  systemctl --failed --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 >> "$OUT" || true
else
  echo 'systemctl: not available' >> "$OUT"
fi

section "Обновления (проверка доступности)"
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -qq 2>&1 || true
  apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf check-update 2>&1 | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yum check-update 2>&1 | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  zypper lu 2>&1 | head -n 100 >> "$OUT" || true
else
  echo 'No known package manager found' >> "$OUT"
fi

section "Логи ядра"
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl -k -n 200 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 >> "$OUT" || true
else
  if [ -r /var/log/kern.log ]; then
    echo '--- /var/log/kern.log (last 200 lines) ---' >> "$OUT"
    tail -n 200 /var/log/kern.log >> "$OUT" || true
  fi
  if [ -r /var/log/messages ]; then
    echo '--- /var/log/messages (kernel lines, last 200) ---' >> "$OUT"
    grep -i kernel /var/log/messages | tail -n 200 >> "$OUT" || true
  fi
fi

section "Системные логи (кратко)"
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl -n 200 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -n 200 >> "$OUT" || true
else
  for f in /var/log/syslog /var/log/messages /var/log/daemon.log; do
    if [ -r "$f" ]; then
      echo "--- $f (last 200 lines) ---" >> "$OUT"
      tail -n 200 "$f" >> "$OUT" || true
    fi
  done
fi

echo "Audit collected at $(date --iso-8601=seconds)" >> "$OUT"
echo "Report: $OUT"
EOS
  chmod +x /tmp/collect_vps_audit.sh
}
"}
